scoreMeaning: Schema placeholder for unscored source correctness review; not a visual, comparative or element quality score.
profile: read-only Node; no browser or rendering
tier: not applicable to CPU navigation fixture
blindComparison: No blind comparison was conducted. No prediction of a stranger preference is made; E-13 remains not measured and this source/CPU refutation cannot change its element status.

findings.problem: In the current City CPU fixture, live gas changes after 60 simulated seconds and an intensity change, while the entire stored navigation cost buffer remains byte-identical to its initial state.
findings.why: Reactive avoidance planning cannot use the current hazard distribution through the navigation cost map; the source applies gas cost only at City construction.
findings.fix: After meaningful gas changes refresh or invalidate navigation hazard costs with a bounded schedule; rerun this actual City control and require stored costs to match current gas within the documented update delay.
findings.hypothesis: Confirmed source mechanism: only src/world/city.js calls applyGasCost; GasField.update/setIntensity/setSourceActive do not update NavGrid.
findings.evidence: dynamicCosts in this file. This proves stale planner costs; it does not prove that all enemy behaviour remains unchanged after rigVent.

findings.problem: Actual A* predecessors avoid the central costly plume, but findPath returns only the start and target on a straight line through cost 6.5; the raw detour maximum cost is below 1.38.
findings.why: Cost-aware node search is undone by walkability-only string pulling even when the cost map is freshly computed.
findings.fix: Preserve hazard-aware route choice during smoothing. Re-run the 13x9 GasField fixture recorded here and require returned segments to preserve the lower exposure detour instead of crossing the central cost 6.5 cell.
findings.hypothesis: Confirmed source and CPU mechanism: _clear reads height/bounds only, allowing the detour waypoints to be removed.
findings.evidence: smoothing in this file; real NavGrid, CollisionWorld and GasField, constructed geometry.

findings.shot: CPU 4m direct steering across a plume
findings.problem: At a clear 4 m hop the actual AI movement helper discards a stored detour, makes zero pathfinder calls, and requests straight movement toward the central plume despite the populated gas costs.
findings.why: Refreshing planner costs and fixing string pulling alone will not affect this normal short-hop steering branch.
findings.fix: Make the short-hop decision account for hazard exposure or preserve a safe current detour. Re-run directShortcut with the same 4 m target and require the unsafe shortcut not to discard the recorded detour.
findings.hypothesis: Confirmed source and CPU mechanism: the d<6 / collision LOS branch bypasses NavGrid and does not query GasField.
findings.evidence: directShortcut in this file; requested direction only, not proof an enemy completes the crossing before panic.

findings.shot: Actual City / shutVents / world-source save and restore
findings.problem: All three West Heads sources are registered with id=null. The real shutVents hook receives false for each attempted source deactivation, leaves their emissions active and only enables yard_seep; its marker/plume deactivation calls still run.
findings.why: The visible operation claims the heads were shut while those same source emissions continue. The coupled-world consequence is wrong independently of navigation cost staleness.
findings.fix: Give each authored controllable vent one consistent nonempty ID shared by source, marker/plume, reset and save. Require shutVents results true for all three IDs, halfVents true for exactly vent_west_2, and saved/restored source rows to preserve the choice. Preserve older saves missing these newly named rows through a defined choice-state fallback.
findings.hypothesis: Confirmed registration mismatch: City._prop takes p.gasId||null while these three props declare only p.id. No duplicate named registration exists to absorb the hook. Reset and save/restore also address IDs, so neither repairs the missing identity.
findings.evidence: westVentIdentityReview in this file; real current City, Director._hooks/save/resetWorld/applySave and Storage serialization in an in-memory storage shim. Non-gas NPC rendering and atmospheric methods are stubs; their calls, not visible effects, are recorded.

directShortcut.scope: Real _moveTowards with a stored detour, actual collision world, gas and NavGrid; desired movement is measured, not an integrated travelled trajectory.

dynamicCosts.scope: Independent actual full City CPU build; only GasField.setIntensity(2) then 120 updates of 0.5s, no Game actor or narrative execution. Source search establishes runtime Game uses gas.update and has no navigation refresh caller.

overclaimRefutation.claim: Gas has no effect on enemy routes or behaviour at all.
overclaimRefutation.scope: Uses real Enemy perception/localPpm/Actor.setMove/AISystem._updateEnemy/_flee methods, real GasField and Lungs, with constructor state set in memory and no renderer or physics integration. Clear air stays idle; high air emits gaspanic, enters FLEE and requests movement down the sampled gradient. This establishes existing reactive steering, not reliable obstacle-free escape or global cost-optimal movement.

limitations: No reference media or valid blind comparison is used.
The source search and actual City intensity control confirm stale cost; narrative rigVent execution is separately measured by the parent, not claimed by this fixture.
No browser, visual behaviour, physical phone FPS, or complete enemy movement trajectory was measured.
Known gas-aware panic and sight/respiration paths remain; do not turn a navigation defect into a claim of no gameplay consequence.

paired.scope: Two independently built current Cities; real shutVents hook on one; both real GasFields advance 60 steps of 1/60. This agent did not run Game.fixedUpdate or render atmosphere.

westVentIdentityReview.scope: Read-only Node memory integration. Real world geometry/gas and actual Director methods; appearance stubs; player null; no actor spawn/physics/browser/persistent write. Marker/plume call intent is measured, not visible output.
westVentIdentityReview.saveCompatibilityInference: Current saves store vents_shut/vents_half in story state but omit the null-ID west sources. Merely adding source IDs will not add missing rows to older saved envelopes. applySave resets world then restores listed source IDs; the relevant dialogue-choice hook is not an active quest onEnter. A fix needs an explicit old-save policy without clearing unrelated state.

baselineFinalization.note: All measurements above were completed with the recorded hashes before the coordinator began its product fixes. No subsequent live imports were used to update the baseline.

reproduction.scope: The exact previously executed navigation/detour/panic control code was saved as a reusable current-checkout probe; it prints current source hashes. Only node --check was performed after saving the script. The baseline values are the existing frozen results, not a new run against pending fixes.
